probe: R14 variant-T forward oracle ceiling: per-frame free band x time diagonal gain on the correction output spectrum
role: DIAGNOSTIC, first-order decision aid. NOT a gate judgement, NOT a strict upper bound on variant T, NOT a falsification.
boundary_declaration: This is the ceiling of a band x time DIAGONAL GAIN family acting on the FINAL correction output spectrum. The real variant T gate sits at an INTERMEDIATE layer with further spectral blocks, a 1x1 output conv and nonlinearities after it, and is per-channel over the retained modes only. The two families are not nested in either direction: the real gate can do things the output-side family cannot, and vice versa. First-order decision diagnostic, NOT a strict bound.
DIAGNOSTIC, NOT A GATE JUDGEMENT. Single-record or single-frame ratios must never be quoted beside family-level gate means (RULED_OUT_ROUTES_20260919.md section 5.1, same prohibition).
TRAIN split, and the marmousi family contains 50 m translated twin records (the split leakage disclosed in the paper). The word GENERALISATION must not be applied to any number in this file.

Every ratio is fitted and evaluated on the same 40401 pixels. With B <= 16 parameters the in-sample optimism is ~B/P <= 4e-4 in squared terms; it biases the ceiling DOWNWARDS, so it can only manufacture a false "worth an arm", never a false "no arm".
g is solved independently per frame, i.e. free in t with no parameterisation, and absorbs the correction_scale s, so a shut gate cannot depress the number.

variant_T_reference.gate: g(c, bin(|k|), t) = 1 + A phi(t), A zero-init, phi fixed

config.global_calibre_source: run_identity.json -> effective_config.data; config.py defaults are refused (active_horizon_s default 0.60 asserted against)

spaces.decoder: e = coarse - truth, columns = r_b  (R6-compatible, carries the 0.9984 self-check)
spaces.deployed: e = coarse*surf - truth, columns = r_b*surf, surf = tanh(z/20)^2 (the space the training loss is computed in; carries the verdict)

r_capture.exact: forward hook on dense_decoder.output -> the correction tensor before s
r_capture.r6recipe: (y - coarse)/s, the R6 recipe; loses ~1e-2 relative precision to float32 cancellation because ||s*r*surf||/||coarse*surf|| ~ 9.3e-06
